h1: EV WORLD360: A Website for an EV Charging Solutions Provider

sections.intro: EV WORLD360 provides electric vehicle charging solutions. We designed and developed its website to explain its charging products, software and partnership programs to homeowners, businesses and resellers.
overview: Buyers of EV charging equipment ask different questions depending on who they are: a homeowner wants a home charger, a business wants commercial or DC fast charging, and a reseller wants a partnership. The EV WORLD360 website gives each of them a route from the main menu and the home page.
A home page intro video, dedicated charging solution pages, a software page, an FAQ and a blog give visitors the information they need before they get in touch.
sections.goalsHeading: What the EV charging website needed to do
goals: Explain three charger types, home, commercial and DC fast, without overwhelming visitors.
Recruit partners through white label and reseller programs.
Answer common questions in an FAQ and share advice through a blog.
sections.featuresHeading: What the EV charging website includes

features.title: A charging solutions menu
features.body: Home Charger, Commercial Charger and DC Fast Charger each have their own page, reached from one drop-down menu.

features.title: A software page
features.body: A dedicated page introduces the company's charging software, separate from the hardware.

features.title: Partnership programs
features.body: White label and reseller programs invite businesses to work with the company.

features.title: FAQ and blog
features.body: Common questions are answered in an FAQ, and blog articles cover EV maintenance and charging topics.

features.title: A home page intro video
features.body: A play button on the home page opens an introduction to the company.

features.title: Bold branding and responsive layout
features.body: Green brand colours and large headlines carry through the design, which adapts from desktop to phone.

sections.audience: Homeowners, businesses and organisations looking for EV charging, and companies interested in reselling or white-labelling charging solutions.
